roof / azotea is a common element unless the bylaws grant exclusive use

pending development dues attach to the plot and bind a buyer

developer sale → VAT 10%; AJD on mortgage deeds paid by the lender

complaint service must answer within 15 days; OMIC; consumer arbitration
comparables of the same zone, use and building type
